SELECT T1.CustomerID, T1.Consumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
WHERE T1.Date LIKE '2012%'
  AND T1.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers

  )

SELECT AVG(Consumption) / 12 AS AverageMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'SME' AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) 
     FROM yearmonth 
     INNER JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
     WHERE customers.Currency = 'CZK' AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212') -
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) 
     FROM yearmonth 
     INNER JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
     WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR' AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212') AS DifferenceInConsumption

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) AS Year, SUM(T1.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY Year
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUBSTR(T1.Date, 5, 2) AS Month,
    MAX(T1.Consumption) AS PeakConsumption
FROM 
    yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    customers AS T2
ON 
    T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T2.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY 
    Year, Month
ORDER BY 
    PeakConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH LAM AS (
    SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS LAM_Avg
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND CustomerID IN (
          SELECT CustomerID
          FROM customers
          WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
          ORDER BY Consumption ASC
          LIMIT 1
      )
),
SME AS (
    SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS SME_Avg
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND CustomerID IN (
          SELECT CustomerID
          FROM customers
          WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
          ORDER BY Consumption ASC
          LIMIT 1
      )
),
KAM AS (
    SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS KAM_Avg
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND CustomerID IN (
          SELECT CustomerID
          FROM customers
          WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
          ORDER BY Consumption ASC
          LIMIT 1
      )
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM LAM) - (SELECT SME_Avg FROM SME) AS LAM_SME_Diff,
    (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM LAM) - (SELECT KAM_Avg FROM KAM) AS LAM_KAM_Diff,
    (SELECT SME_Avg FROM SME) - (SELECT KAM_Avg FROM KAM) AS SME_KAM_Diff

SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    MAX(((T2.Consumption - T1.Consumption) / T2.Consumption) * 100) AS MaxPercentageIncrease,
    MIN(((T2.Consumption - T1.Consumption) / T2.Consumption) * 100) AS MinPercentageDecrease
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    yearmonth T1 ON c.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID AND T1.Date LIKE '2012%'
JOIN 
    yearmonth T2 ON c.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%'
WHERE 
    c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY 
    c.Segment

SELECT

    ABS(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
),
OldestFemaleClient AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM FemaleClients
    ORDER BY birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
LowestSalaryClient AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM FemaleClients)
    ORDER BY (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district WHERE district_id = client.district_id) ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
HighestSalaryClient AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM FemaleClients)
    ORDER BY (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district WHERE district_id = client.district_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
LowestSalaryAccount AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM LowestSalaryClient)
),
HighestSalaryAccount AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM HighestSalaryClient)
),
SalaryGap AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM HighestSalaryClient))) -
        (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM LowestSalaryClient))) AS gap
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT account_id FROM LowestSalaryAccount) AS lowest_salary_account,
    (SELECT account_id FROM HighestSalaryAccount) AS highest_salary_account,
    (SELECT gap FROM SalaryGap) AS salary_gap
